agent_explanation: Body starts 0.1m from thin wall (w=0.2) with high velocity (~55.6 m/s, vx=-33.1, vy=-44.6) and dt=0.032. Displacement between steps (~1.06m in x) exceeds wall thickness, so centre crosses through wall box between steps 0 and 1. Substep count 60 insufficient and CCD/tunneling check fails to prevent crossing. Reducing dt to 0.001 (smaller displacement per substep) avoids tunneling.
